exclude_seasons.en.1/2019-20: entire season withheld until the 66 misdated results have evidence-backed corrections

protocol.brier_definition: sum of squared errors across three classes; no division by 3
protocol.calibration_definition: 10 equal-width bins, top-label ECE plus one-vs-rest reliability per class
protocol.temporal_protocol: expanding walk-forward features; whole date predicted before any same-date result update; challenger weights frozen at each fold start; final model selected on validation only

limitations: Accepted for date-batched experimental training, NOT externally verified results/timezones or production provider identity. Source dates may contain undetected errors.
Retrospective replay of corrected-later source, not prospective snapshots
95% season coverage gate; missing La Liga 2024/25 results may cause selection bias
Date-cluster CI does not fully model season/team dependence
No odds, injuries, xG or target-match post-kickoff features
